logline: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
continuity_notes: Picks up the morning after Episode 16's moonlit confrontation where Alexander defended Juliana and defeated Harrington's hired thugs in her medicinal garden.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High angle wide shot looking down at the muddy, trampled garden. Broken wooden planters and splintered planks litter the ground as Juliana kneels amidst the ruined soil.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Emotional)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Some of them survived.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.

segments.label: JULIANA (Grateful, Sincere)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff, Low)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: For what?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

segments.label: JULIANA (Trembling, Heartfelt)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: For standing between me and those men.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Unwavering, Firm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I would do it again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Awed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Even if there were ten of them?

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: As long as I draw breath...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Vowing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: ...no one will hurt you again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

segments.label: JULIANA (Choked Up, Pained)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You cannot promise that.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Absolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I just did.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.

segments.label: JULIANA (Tender, Reproachful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You were bleeding last night.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Fond)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: So were you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.

segments.label: JULIANA (Softly Teasing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You make it very difficult to argue with you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.

segments.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Sincere)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I was frightened.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Questioning)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Of them?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana gazing directly into his eyes, her heart laid bare.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Earnest)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Of losing you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander visibly moved, his gaze softening with profound emotion.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stands and pulls Juliana gently to her feet against his broad chest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on their faces nestled together in the firelight, Alexander resting his bearded chin against her hair.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Playful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your heart is racing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander tilting his head down toward her, a tender smile breaking through his rugged beard.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Warm, Whispering)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: So is yours.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the couple embraced in front of the roaring, glowing fireplace.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of her delicate fingers running through his thick strands of hair.

segments.label: JULIANA (Lighthearted, Teasing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: This is becoming impossible.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana beaming up at him with affectionate humor.

segments.label: JULIANA (Smiling)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Soon birds will start nesting in it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander regarding her with a subtle, affectionate smirk.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dry, Amused)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They have not complained yet.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up as Juliana lifts her bandaged hand toward his beard playfully.

segments.label: JULIANA (Charming, Tender)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then I shall have to save you from the birds.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn, Gentle)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Not yet.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes shining with quiet patience and understanding.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sweet, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then I will wait.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander releasing a quiet breath of gratitude, pulling her closer against his shoulder.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's peaceful face resting against Alexander's rugged chest.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Resonant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I know almost nothing about the man I married.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow pull-back wide shot of Alexander and Juliana locked in a tender, enduring embrace before the radiant, roaring hearth as the fire crackles peacefully.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Deeply Moved, Loving)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.
